items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Critical Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization (B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92 - Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin - APSB25-71
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-73
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution. Attacks were observed in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application. It has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files to any store using a polyglot to bypass validation. Sansec observed attacks on 79.5% of all stores.
